test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.**

My brother is a __connoisseur of food__ and does not miss any chance to experiment with new dishes.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3 i.e. Gourmet.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Connoisseur of food **means a person who has expert knowledge of something, esp. an art, food, or drink, and is qualified to judge and appreciate its quality. (अच्छे भोजन का पारखी)
 
• **Gourmet **me
